_comment: Spotlight Campaign tuning + content (IP-free). Card ids only.

smugglers_stash.name: Smuggler's Stash
smugglers_stash.desc: Start every battle with 1 extra resource.

veteran_crew.name: Veteran Crew
veteran_crew.desc: Your first unit each battle enters with an Experience token.

deflector_array.name: Deflector Array
deflector_array.desc: Your first unit each battle enters with a Shield token.

intel_network.name: Intel Network
intel_network.desc: Draw 1 extra card in your opening hand.

battle_plans.name: Battle Plans
battle_plans.desc: The Plan token is available in every battle.

orbital_strike.name: Orbital Strike
orbital_strike.desc: The Blast token is available in every battle.

bacta_tanks.name: Bacta Tanks
bacta_tanks.desc: Heal 3 base damage after every victory.

kyber_crystal.name: Kyber Crystal
kyber_crystal.desc: Your Force token starts in play every battle.

events.title: Smuggler's Offer
events.desc: A Corellian smuggler offers a crate of 'misplaced' cargo — for a price.

choices.label: Buy the crate (30 credits): gain a card from your Spotlight deck
Rob him blind: gain 25 credits, take 4 base damage

events.title: Jawa Traders
events.desc: Utinni! A sandcrawler full of salvage rolls up beside you.

choices.label: Trade away a card (remove one from your deck) for 20 credits
Buy salvage (15 credits): gain a random loot card

events.title: Derelict Freighter
events.desc: A dead freighter drifts in the shipping lane. Something still has power.

choices.label: Board it: gain a card from your Spotlight deck, take 3 base damage

events.title: Force Vision
events.desc: The Force shows you what could be.

choices.label: Embrace it: a card in your deck gains a permanent Experience token

events.title: Bounty Board
events.desc: A Guild posting offers credits for dangerous work.

choices.label: Take the job: +40 credits, take 6 base damage

events.title: Cantina Brawl
events.desc: Someone shot first. Chairs are flying.

choices.label: Join in: gain a random loot card, take 3 base damage
Slip out the back with a dropped purse (+10 credits)

events.title: Checkpoint
events.desc: A security checkpoint blocks the route.

choices.label: Blast through: take 5 base damage, gain 15 credits from the lockbox

events.title: Lost Holocron
events.desc: An ancient holocron hums with knowledge.

choices.label: Open it: gain a random perk, lose 5 max base HP
